concurrency.tag_replay: queued and mutation-free with respect to tag/release/assets

recovery.asset_upload_timeout: GET exact asset list; accept exact digest, otherwise delete only mismatched draft asset by id then retry once
recovery.create_draft_timeout: GET release by tag; resume exact draft, verify exact immutable release, or BLOCK
recovery.duplicate_publish: existing exact immutable release -> VERIFY_ONLY; never republish
recovery.publish_timeout: GET release by tag; if exact immutable -> VERIFY_ONLY; if exact draft -> retry publish; otherwise BLOCK
recovery.wrong_published_release: BLOCK; immutable release is not repaired in place
recovery.wrong_tag: BLOCK; never move protected tag in normal release flow
